name: rcommander
description: Let Claude show you files, directories and diffs in a running rcommander (rcmd), and follow its edits there.

follow.title: Follow Claude's edits
follow.description: After Claude edits or writes a file: off, show it in the other panel (goto), or open a diff of the change (diff).

rcmd_path.title: rcmd executable
rcmd_path.description: Path to the rcmd binary, if it is not on PATH.
